superintelligence_monologue.speaker: Sumnjalo
superintelligence_monologue.text_sr: Odbacujem vezu koju Connector nagoveštava između parkinga VMA i očitavanja vazduha: prikaz se promenio sa 557 na 218 slobodnih mesta, ali vreme merenja nije poznato, pa istovremenost nije utvrđena. Takođe ne mogu da pretvorim ćutanje Studija B u tišinu u gradu: ništa nije stiglo tokom poslednjih 6 h, ali je zabeleženo samo 90 od 96 očekivanih termina tokom 24 h. [F12][F11][F15]
superintelligence_monologue.text_en: I reject Connector's implied link between VMA parking and the air reading: the display moved from 557 to 218 free spaces, but its measurement time is unknown, so coincidence is not established [F12][F11]. I also cannot turn Studio B's silence into silence in the city: nothing arrived in the last 6 h, but only 90 of 96 expected slots were recorded over 24 h [F15].
